_why: Careers page carries a req for a role a B2B SaaS revenue tool directly supports. This is the highest-value signal kind in the brief and must score above threshold.

pages.title: Northwind Logistics - freight visibility for mid-market shippers

items.text: Northwind gives mid-market shippers one dashboard for every carrier, lane and exception. 340 shippers moved 1.2M loads with us last year.

Revenue Operations Manager - Own the go-to-market data stack end to end. You will untangle our lead routing, rebuild reporting that the sales team currently maintains by hand in spreadsheets, and own the handoff between marketing-sourced and outbound pipeline. Remote (US).

Sales Development Representative (2 openings) - We are building out our first dedicated outbound team. You will be among the first SDRs at Northwind, working new-logo accounts in food and beverage distribution. Chicago or remote.
Senior Backend Engineer - Go, Postgres, event-driven carrier integrations. Chicago hybrid.
Shipped: lane-level benchmark reporting. Customers can now compare their own cost per mile against anonymised peer data on the same lane.
Why we are finally building an outbound motion. For six years every Northwind customer came inbound. That stopped scaling last quarter, so we are hiring a team to go get the next 300.
